Requiring DirectX 9 typically means that it does use DirectX. DirectX 9 is a rather old version of DirectX at this point though, as [AFAIK] only XP is limited to 9. Windows Vista/7 have 10, Win 8 has 10.1, Win 8.1 has 11, and Windows 10 will have DirectX 12. Newer DirectXs usually have more features and optimizations to take advantage of newer hardware, however they do require newer hardware, and newer operating systems. C# usually means it will use DirectX, but not always. I am not sure how well OpenGL works on C#.

Hopefully Microsoft's open sourcing of .NET helps Mono along so that this can be ported easier!

Multi-national food company Unilever, manufacturers of brands like Best Foods and Hellmann's mayonnaise, is suing San Francisco-based Hampton Creek over its Just Mayo vegan mayonnaise. Claiming it can't be "real" mayonnaise because "it does not include any egg," Unilever's complaint demands that the vegan company stop using the "Just Mayo" name, that all product is removed from store shelves, and that they are entitled to Hampton Creek's profits plus lawyer's fees and damages. According to the lawsuit, Unilever cites a 1957 regulation that mayonnaise should include "egg yolk-containing ingredients" and that "Hampton Creek is seizing market share from Unilever's Best Foods and Hellmann's brands of mayonnaise products." A Change.org petition has been started by celebrity chef Andrew Zimmern to generate support for Hampton Creek.

But without the government, who will protect consumers from thinking egg free mayonnaise contains egg? Nice to see an upstanding company like unilever has our back. It's very good of them to stand up for us consumers like that and demand their competitor's profits.
